title: Applying a Higher Verification Level to a Personal Sender Account
content:
When a Personal Sender Account holder asks to be moved up to a higher verification level and the agent applies the upgrade, the upgrade sets two things at once: the level the account now holds, and the date its next periodic identity (KYC) review falls due. That date is fixed by the refresh interval of the upgraded account, a whole number of calendar months counted forward from the upgrade date.

## Effect of the upgrade

One call changes the account's verification level to the level named and records today as the date the new level took effect: its sending limits, funding methods and service entitlements apply to transfers booked from today. It also sets the next periodic review due date to the date the given number of whole calendar months from today, on the same day of the month or on the last day of a shorter month. The account status, its documents and every transfer already booked stay as they are. The customer sees the new level and its limits in the app.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks the tool `apply_level_upgrade_725c1de1` (with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

## Parameters

**`sender_account_id`** — the Personal Sender Account reference number of the account being moved up, as returned by the Personal Sender Account lookup for this customer.

**`new_level`** — the official name of the level the account moves to, exactly one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Paloma Starter` | the entry level (level 1), held from opening without documents |
| `Paloma Verified` | level 2, held with an accepted photo ID and selfie |
| `Paloma Verified Plus` | level 3, held with the further SSN or ITIN, address, occupation documents, account age and completed transfers it requires |
| `Paloma Enhanced` | level 4, granted only by an approved compliance limit review |
| `Paloma Premier` | level 5, granted only by an approved compliance limit review |
| `Paloma Private Client` | level 6, granted only by an approved compliance limit review |

**`review_interval_months`** — the number of whole calendar months from today to the next periodic review: an integer of 1 or more with no fractional part; the tool applies no rounding. The next review due date recorded is in YYYY-MM-DD form on Paloma's operations calendar (US Central Time), the same day of the month that many months on, or the last day of that month when it is shorter.

## Return

A successful call returns a text rendering of a dictionary with these fields:

- `sender_account_id` — the account moved up;
- `level` — the official name of the level now held;
- `level_effective_date` — today's date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `next_review_due_date` — the date the next periodic review falls due, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `status` — "upgraded" when the change was recorded.

A receipt with status "upgraded" means the account now holds the level named.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Called on 31 January with `new_level` set to `Paloma Verified Plus` and `review_interval_months` set to 13, the call returns status "upgraded", 31 January as `level_effective_date`, and the last day of February of the following year as `next_review_due_date`. The interval value is an arbitrary input chosen for the illustration.
